notes.title: Corn Defenders Askii Edition
notes.content:
I'm currently writing a python script that will imitate the popular game, corn defenders. Right now it doesn't have much, but it has some features as - 
[list]
Ability to move between rooms
WSAD movement
How to play screen
Dr. Small chasing you around
Very basic artwork
[/list] 
It's all text base out of the CMD terminal and not the speediest program ever, but it works. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42191910/934e53029fae1a612a4ce7ea761c33b3eca37356.png[/img]
I'm not quite sure how I'm going to release it yet, either through steam or just add a download link on my website [url=alxcorn.com]alxcorn.com[/url]
Should be released soon. I just have to code the map into the game, which shouldn't take too long.

notes.title: Skiing Update
notes.content:
Instead of just dying from going through the broken wall in the snow room. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42191910/a0d1c47360b1eb5a7973d89958c9446a177bfc60.png[/img]

You will now be allowed to play a [i]3d[/i] minigame to get a piece corn. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42191910/bd06d2035acc6743c1e1f331c58b8cc4c2c73931.png[/img]

There is 3 lives for the skiing minigame, if those 3 lives are taken up, you will lose a heart. Even if you lose once you can still retry. Each retry will start with 3 lives again,

Also added a options menu which can change your  window type and volume level.
